book.name: Eksadas
book.title: Eksadas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Libum Ijip

content: God bin gibit daga langa ola Isreil pipul

Brom deya detlot Isreil pipul bin kipgon na, en deibin kamat langa det deset kantri gulum Sin langa midul langa dubala kantri gulum Ilim en Sainai, en imbin det namba 15 dei blanga det sekan manth afta deibin gowei brom Ijip.
Wal deya na langa det deset kantri ola Isreil pipul bin stat agamin langa Mosis en Eran,

“Wotfo yunbala bin bringimap melabat blanga meigim melabat dai iya langa dijan deset kantri nomo garram daga? Melabat bin abum loda bif en olkain daga deya langa Ijip. Mobeda YAWEI det trubala God bina meigim melabat dai deya.”

Wal YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis, “Ai garra meigim daga buldan brom top jis laik rein blanga yumob, en ai garra testim detlot pipul blanga faindat if dei garra lisin langa mi. Wal ebridei ola pipul garra go en gajim naf daga blanga det dei.
Bat langa det namba 6 dei, dei garra gajim en gugum naf daga blanga 2 dei.”

Wal Mosis en Eran bin tok langa ol detlot pipul, “Wen yumob agamin langa minbala, yumob nomo agamin langa minbala. Yumob agamin langa YAWEI. Wal sangodantaim tudei yumob garra sabi YAWEI na bin bringimap yumob iya brom Ijip, en ailibala yumob garra luk det shainiwan lait blanga im.”

Wal Mosis bin kipgon tok, “Sangodantaim YAWEI garra gibit yumob bif blanga dagat, en ailibala im garra gibit yumob detmatj damba blanga dagat, dumaji imbin irrim yumob wen yumob bin agamin langa im. Yumob sabi na? Wen yumob gitwail langa minbala, yumob gitwail langa im du.”
Wal Mosis bin tok langa Eran na, “Yu dalim ol detlot pipul blanga kaman en jandap lida langa YAWEI, dumaji YAWEI bin irrim olabat wen deibin agamin langa im.”
Wal Eran bin tok langa detlot pipul na, en wen deibin luk streit langa det deset, deibin luk det shainiwan lait blanga YAWEI bin kamat brom det klaud.
Afta na YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis,

“Aibin irrim detlot pipul weya deibin agamin langa mi. Wal yu dalim olabat sangodantaim dei garra dagat bif, en ailibala dei garra dagat damba detmatj, en afta dei garra sabi mi na YAWEI det God blanga olabat.”
Wal sangodantaim detmatj lilwan bard gulum kweil bin kaman, en deibin jidan ebriweya langa graun langa detlot pipul kemp, en ailibala hebiwan dyu bin gaburrumap detlot kemp,
en wen det dyu bin gowap, detmatj brabli lilwan daga bin jidan ebriweya langa graun. Det daga bin difrinkain daga,
en wen ola Isreil pipul bin luk, dei nomo bin sabi det daga, en deibin tok, “Wanim dijan?” Wal Mosis bin tok, “Dijan na det damba weya YAWEI bin gibit langa yumob blanga dagat,
en imbin dalim yumob blanga gajim haumatj yumob wandim. Yumob garra bilimap wanbala dish ful blanga ebriwan langa yumob kemp.” Det dish weya deibin oldei meshurumap det daga bin 2 lita.
Wal detlot Isreil pipul bin dum wanim Mosis bin dalim olabat. Bat sambala pipul bin gajim blendibala daga, en sambala pipul bin gajim lilbit daga,

en wen deibin bilimap olabat dish, ebribodi bin abum naf. Detlot pipul hubin gajim blendibala daga nomo bin abum eni leftobawan daga, en detlot pipul hubin gajim lilbit daga nomo bin shot blanga daga. Deibin ol abum naf daga blanga dagat wanim deibin wandim.
Wal Mosis bin tok langa olabat na, “Yumob kaan seibum eni daga blanga tumorro.”

Bat sambala pipul nomo bin lisin langa Mosis, en deibin seibum sambala daga, en ailibala neksdei det daga bin abum detmatj wibul, en imbin smel brabli nogudwan, en Mosis bin gitwail langa detlot pipul.
Wal ebri ailibala detlot pipul bin oldei gajim naf daga weya deibin wandim, en wen det san bin go hot, detlot daga weya deibin libum langa graun nomo bin deya na, dumaji detlot daga bin oldei meltap.

Langa det namba 6 dei ola pipul bin gajim naf daga blanga dubala dei, en deibin bilimap dubala dish blanga ebriwan, en afta ola boswan blanga detlot pipul bin go langa Mosis, en deibin dalim im olabat bin duwit.

Wal Mosis bin tok langa detlot boswan, “YAWEI bin tok wi garra abum spel tumorro, dumaji det namba 7 dei im det speshalwan dei blanga im. Wal tudei na yumob garra gugum wanim yumob wandim, en yumob garra seibum ola leftobawan daga blanga tumorro.”
Wal wen Mosis bin tok lagijat langa olabat, deibin seibum det daga, en neksdei det daga nomo bin go nogud garram wibul,
en Mosis bin tok, “Tudei na yumob garra dagat dis daga, dumaji im det speshalwan dei blanga YAWEI, en yumob kaan faindim eni daga tudei.
Langa 6 dei yumob garra gajim det daga. Bat langa dis namba 7 dei weya wi gulum Sebathdei, yumob kaan faindim eni daga blanga gajim.”
Wal sambala pipul bin trai en lukabat daga langa det Sebathdei. Bat dei nomo bin faindim eni daga.
Afta na YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis, “Wotfo detlot pipul kaan bulurrum ol detlot lowa main en duwit langa mi?

Yumob garra oldei jinggabat dis Sebathdei weya aibin gibit langa yumob blanga abum spel. Blanga tharran na langa det namba 6 dei aibin gibit yumob naf daga blanga dubala dei, en ebribodi garra jidan langa olabat kemp det Sebathdei. Nomo enibodi lau go wokabat.”
Wal wen YAWEI bin tok lagijat, ola pipul nomo bin dum eni wek langa det namba 7 dei.
Wal detlot Isreil pipul bin gulum det daga mena. Imbin luk jis laik lil waitwan sid, en imbin abum teist jis laik biskit garram shugabeig.

Afta na Mosis bin tok, “YAWEI bin tok wi garra seibum sambala mena wulijim ola biginini blanga wi hu garra bulurrum wi biyain garra luk wotkain daga imbin gibit langa wi wen imbin deigidawei wi brom Ijip.”

Wal Mosis bin tok langa Eran, “Wi garra spilim wanbala dish ful garram mena insaid langa dram, en wi garra pudum det dram weya YAWEI wandim wi garra kipum det mena daga blanga ola Isreil pipul hu garra bulurrum wi biyain.”
Wal bambai wen deibin meigim det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI, imbin dalim Mosis blanga dalim Eran blanga pudum det dram lida langa det Seikridwan Boks, en deya na deibin oldei kipum det dram.
Wal blanga 40 yiya detlot Isreil pipul bin oldei dagadagat det daga gulum mena. Deibin dagat det daga raidap deibin go en jidan langa det kantri gulum Keinan.
